previous_questions.question: What details should the methods section of a scientific paper provide so that another scientist can reproduce the experiment?
How do gated ion channels help nerve cells transmit electrical signals and muscle cells contract?
Why can the same signaling molecule cause different responses in different types of cells?
How are the short and long arms of a chromosome named?
Why might recombination hotspots make a genetic linkage map differ from a physical map of the genome?
How does a temperate bacteriophage preserve its DNA during lysogeny, and what can trigger a return to the lytic cycle?
Why do liverwort thalli generally need moist habitats despite having openings for gas exchange?
What skeletal and finger features helped pterosaurs support their large membranous wings?
Which cells make the matrix of cartilage, and what are the spaces containing these cells called?
How can too little dietary iodine cause an enlarged thyroid even when TSH is elevated?
Why does filtrate become more dilute as it travels up the ascending limb of the loop of Henle?
How is species diversity defined for a biological community?
What happens to carbon fixed in the Calvin cycle: what does RuBisCO combine with CO2, how does the resulting compound become G3P, and why does some G3P leave while the rest remains?
